propositions: Operators frequently use --force to close tickets with administrative reasons (duplicate, obsolete, superseded, wontfix) because no truthful non-force path exists for non-bug ticket types (tasks, stories, epics).
The completion-verification failure message never mentions the narrow attested-disposition path that exists, leaving operators unaware of valid alternatives to --force.
Non-bug closes currently cannot use not_a_bug or escalated dispositions, and reason-capable dispositions like obsolete and wontfix have no vocabulary or enforcement support.

A close with an administrative reason-class (obsolete/wontfix) must persist the reason as a distinct close_reason key on the close event, distinct from force_close_reason, and must be signed in the disposition attestation manifest.
The close-precheck refusal message must enumerate the applicable --class values valid for each ticket type so operators discover truthful administrative-disposition exits.
